title: Line reader
hints: The scanner already does the reading and splitting. Your iterator is the `for lr.sc.Scan() { … }` loop from the stdlib-interfaces lesson, with `yield` in place of a print.

Count first (`lr.line++`, so skipped lines are counted too), then `strings.TrimSpace(lr.sc.Text())`, then `continue` for `""` or a `#` prefix (`strings.HasPrefix`). Yield `(lr.line, text)` and return when `yield` returns `false`.
